Government jobs/living standards responsibility: original high values prefer individual responsibility. The 2008 OLD half-sample uses the comparable version; NEW uses an alternative version.

The 2012 Sources entry is absent despite observed CDF values. Historical wording differences in 1986/1988 do not alone establish poor comparability in 2004-2024. Source provenance requires further single-wave verification.

General government services/spending explicitly mentions health and education. The 2004 CDF uses the pre-election version. In 2008 NEW uses a branching series.

The official note says the 2012 seven-point scale is incomparable, not that the question was never administered. This CDF field has no substantive 2012 observations. In 2008 NEW uses a branching series.

Crime spending: codes 1/2/3; code 3 includes cut out entirely before 2012. The prior 2008 source repair is documented in ANES_SOURCE_MAPPING_EVIDENCE_G02B.csv; respondent-level source matching is not rerun here.
Public-school spending: codes 1/2/3; code 3 includes cut out entirely before 2012. Question order varies across years according to the common spending notes.
Welfare-programme spending, not the separate aid-to-the-poor item. Codes 1/2/3; code 3 includes cut out entirely before 2012.

The official Question block explicitly lists 2012: fedspend_enviro although Sources omits the year. The 2004 field is entirely system missing. Code 7 remains a substantive volunteered response; it is not merged or discarded.

All five primary years have documented sources and substantive observations. Code 7 is a separate substantive volunteered response. Historical exclusion rationale is not recovered; the current scope disposition is preserved without claiming data infeasibility.
The title says 4-category but one is DK: substantive codes are only 1/3/5. Prior 2024 source repair uses V242227; its earlier respondent-level matching is not repeated in this audit.
Higher original values mean lower perceived immigration employment threat. The first listed source year is 2004, constraining the common start of this fixed nine-node set.
A constructed seven-category party-identification measure with sources in all six years. Its exclusion concerns policy-versus-identity scope, not data unavailability.
Liberal-conservative self-placement is outside the selected policy-item scope. The 2012 web questionnaire omitted the haven't-thought option; code 9 is non-substantive even when printed under Valid.

CDF substantive coding is 1/2 throughout these years. The 2020 source question's five categories were officially collapsed into the existing binary CDF coding. It is not a policy attitude; binary coding alone is not a validity failure.
